'''2015 European Championship Day 3 Angelo Consoli DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Angelo Consoli]] at [[2015 European Championship]] (Day 3).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor-D-endoroperations.gif|label=Endor Operations}}
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
